topic: fix 'connected to wifi but no internet' error
core_question: My device says connected to wifi but I have no internet access, what do I do?
answer_summary: Unplug both the modem and router from power for about 30 seconds, plug the modem back in first and wait for it to reconnect, then plug the router back in.
